Appium UiAutomator2 server v10.6.6 (io.appium.uiautomator2.server and its test companion).
Source: https://github.com/appium/appium-uiautomator2-server/releases/tag/v10.6.6
Licence: Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

Handset installs it on each phone and uses it as an accessibility helper: fast screen reads, focusing
fields and clicking buttons during automatic sign-in (server/a11y.js). Set FAST_FILL=false to disable it.
